title: Convergent Form, Divergent Voice II — Corpus
description: Research corpus of freeflow and values probes with explicit deployment provenance. Version 1.2.52 adds 245 revision-pinned Phi-3 Medium 4K Instruct BF16 Colab/vLLM traces. No new DOI is claimed. Summary: 68,647 valid samples, 600 probe cells, 200 model labels; deployment labels are not unique-weight identities.
